notes: Modelled: steel bezel with a 90-tooth coin edge, black insert with the white triangle, numerals and minute marks as traced inlays, polished inner lip, applied indices with polished frames and lume (round dots, triangle at 12, bars at 3 and 9), polished date frame, baton hour and minute hands with lume panels, polished seconds hand with a lume dot and T-shaped counterweight, fluted crown in its crown guard, brushed lugs, three-column bracelet (brushed outer links, polished centre links).
From the photo map: black dial with TISSOT 1853, SEASTAR, 30 bar (300m / 1000 ft), SWISS MADE, the date (8) and the grey flange with its minute track.
Under the hands and indices the dial is a smooth fill; it is covered by the 3D parts.
Scale is the official 40 mm case from Tissot's straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled). Heights are a front-relief reading of the official 9.97 mm.
